title: Hardware Cost Estimate
plain_reading: The workload must fit the chip budget for area, memory, energy, latency, and converter use.
what_this_supports: The team can rank whether a workload is a first target, later target, or poor fit.
what_this_does_not_prove: An estimate is not a measured power, area, or latency result.
